name: finances-workspace
description: Monorepo Finances — controle financeiro pessoal (web + API)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run backend:dev" "npm run frontend:dev"
scripts.backend:dev: npm run build -w @finances/shared && npm run start:dev -w finances-api
scripts.backend:prod: npm run build:api && npm run start:prod -w finances-api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @finances/shared && npm run build -w finances-api && npm run build -w finances-frontend
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @finances/shared && npm run build -w finances-api
